title: GoogleSheetsInvoiceSchema
description: Schema definition for Collections Agent Google Sheets CRM dataset

Invoice ID.description: Unique identifier for the invoice (e.g. INV-1001)

Client Name.description: Full name of client or organization

Client Email.description: Contact email address for invoice reminders

Amount.description: Monetary value of the invoice in USD ($)

Due Date.description: Due date formatted strictly as DD-MM-YYYY

Status.description: Current status of the invoice payment

Payment Link.description: Direct payment link or URL for the client

Notes.description: Additional notes or service details for the invoice
